queries:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) AS st_avg
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY observstation, lunarstage
),
phase_avg AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, AVG(st_avg) AS avg_bandwidth
  FROM station_avg
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
phase_cnt AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(DISTINCT telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT c.lunarstage,
       a.avg_bandwidth,
       c.telescope_count,
       c.telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM phase_cnt) AS share
FROM phase_cnt c
JOIN phase_avg a ON a.lunarstage IS c.lunarstage;
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT o.observstation AS observstation,
         o.lunarstage AS lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
),
phase AS (
  SELECT lunarstage,
         AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
         COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) AS station_count
  FROM station_avg
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       avg_bandwidth_usage,
       station_count,
       station_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(station_count) FROM phase) AS share_of_total
FROM phase;
WITH j AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage, o.observstation, t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
st AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM j
  GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       AVG(a) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct,
       SUM(c) AS telescope_count,
       100.0 * SUM(c) / (SELECT SUM(c) FROM st) AS share_pct
FROM st
GROUP BY lunarstage;
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  AVG(station_avg_bw) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
  SUM(cnt) AS telescope_count,
  CAST(SUM(cnt) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM station_avg) AS share
FROM station_avg
GROUP BY lunarstage;
